verdict.rationale: New Relic documents official SDKs of its own: SDK components for building New Relic apps, and APM agents in seven languages that can run as an SDK for instrumentation. However, there is no evidence of official programmatic client SDKs for its data and configuration API (NerdGraph is GraphQL with no OpenAPI spec), so building against the platform programmatically is only partly covered. Missing for 10: official language client SDKs for NerdGraph/API access, SDK reference depth and versioning docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: To help you build New Relic applications, we provide you with the New Relic SDK components, which are used to build New Relic apps.
SDK based instrumentation requires you to enable New Relic agent as an SDK for your chosen runtime.
We've got agents for Go, Java, .NET, Node.js, PHP, Python, and Ruby.
